info.title: RealAddr Operator API
info.description: Same-origin operator API contract. Google OIDC, separate admin sessions, location management and bounded reads are implemented behind disabled-by-default configuration. Live operator login and read-reconciliation execution remain unverified or unavailable. This API cannot approve human actions or force payments.

get.description: Server-side exact filters, stable updatedAt descending then document ID descending order. Opaque cursor binds authenticated operator, filter values, sort, and limit; changing filters resets pagination. Unsupported query names or combinations return 400. No full-text or substring search and no total count scan. Optional id is an exact direct-document lookup, exclusive with cursor and all other filters; limit remains valid, result has zero or one item, and nextCursor is null.

post.summary: Create a location and record operator reason
post.description: Server creates a UUID and fixed environment plan, normalizes Japanese postal code, and stores the location paused. A separate audited update enables sales after operator confirmation and readiness checks. The client cannot set price or slot capacity.

AdminSession.name: realaddr_admin_session
AdminSession.description: Opaque server-side operator session; separate CSRF token required for mutations.

currentVersion.description: Present only for a version conflict on an operator-owned resource

amountAtomic.description: 30-day address price in 6-decimal USDC units: event test/dev 550000; future mainnet profile 55000000 is not currently on sale. The server enforces the environment and verified asset. One-time ENS add-on fees are separate: event floor 100000/custom 300000; future mainnet floor 10000000/custom 30000000, with mainnet sales disabled.

slug.description: Single lowercase ASCII DNS label for the ENS location namespace. No dots; letters/digits at both ends, internal hyphens allowed. The server verifies that ENSIP-15 normalization preserves this exact slug.

postalCode.description: Canonical Japanese seven-digit postal code with hyphen; the create/update request also accepts seven digits without a hyphen and the server normalizes before storing.

status.description: New locations always start paused; enabling sales requires a separate audited update.

publicationConfirmed.description: Must be true when changes.status is available; operator confirms authorization to offer the registered address. The server rejects resumption without it.

ensNameType.description: Selected name type from a paid ENS add-on snapshot; null when no paid entitlement exists.
